window.policy: Events had to be published or substantively advanced within this exact Asia/Kolkata window. Items first reported before the window were excluded unless an in-window primary-source development materially changed the issue. Independent background reporting was not treated as same-event corroboration.

sourcesScanned.scope: All Union government releases in the window
sourcesScanned.result: Reviewed all 68 releases dated 10 August 2026. Shortlisted the 1601-series telecom numbering framework, PLFS April-June 2026 bulletin, additional e-visa ports, student-suicide parliamentary answer, river-linking status and the Asiatic-lion release; the remainder were routine operational notices, speeches, ceremonies, scheme updates or low-novelty answers.

sourcesScanned.scope: TRAI framework for allocation and use of the 1601 numbering series
sourcesScanned.result: Verified Phase I coverage of utilities, courier and logistics entities, direct assignment to verified eligible entities and a 90-day TSP onboarding period; no independent trusted same-event report was indexed by cutoff.

sourcesScanned.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation via PIB
sourcesScanned.result: Verified overall LFPR of 54.6%, unchanged urban LFPR of 50.2%, urban WPR of 46.8% and urban unemployment rate of 6.7%; no independent trusted same-event analysis was found by cutoff.

sourcesScanned.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs via PIB and Indian Visa Online
sourcesScanned.result: Verified nine land ports and two airports, taking the listed total to 88 ports; the exact 10 August action lacked a directly accessible trusted independent report and scored below the CLAT threshold.

sourcesScanned.publisher: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change via PIB
sourcesScanned.result: The figure of 891 lions repeated an already public census result independently reported months earlier; no substantive in-window novelty was identified.

sourcesScanned.scope: Bills introduced or passed in the window
sourcesScanned.result: Verified introduction of four Lok Sabha bills on 10 August 2026 and Lok Sabha passage of the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026. None had an independent trusted same-event report indexed by the 06:03 IST cutoff.

sourcesScanned.scope: Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 as passed by Lok Sabha
sourcesScanned.result: Verified creation of a National Tribunals Commission, its composition, selection and oversight functions, five-year Commission-member terms and the National Tribunals Data Grid framework.

sourcesScanned.scope: Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026 as introduced
sourcesScanned.result: Verified proposed Union control over mineral-bearing lands and proposed section 9D restricting State taxes, cesses and levies on mineral rights or mineral-bearing lands.

sourcesScanned.scope: Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026 as introduced
sourcesScanned.result: Verified the proposal to replace Kerala with Keralam in the First and Fourth Schedules and in Articles 31A and 290A, following the Article 3 consultation process.

sourcesScanned.scope: National Cooperative Development Corporation (Amendment) Bill, 2026 as introduced
sourcesScanned.result: Verified proposed expansion of NCDC financing, participation and information-sharing powers; no same-event independent report was found.

Reviewed the two reportable judgments and selected orders. Harpreet Sawhney concerned income deductions and maintenance; State of Andhra Pradesh v Ponthati Siva Rami Reddy concerned evidentiary insufficiency in a fact-specific criminal appeal. Procedural orders in AAMSU and Arvind Ganpat Sawant produced no substantive legal outcome.

sourcesScanned.scope: Harpreet Sawhney v Puneet Sharma, 2026 INSC 822
sourcesScanned.result: Verified that provident-fund and employee stock-purchase deductions benefiting the husband were distinguished from mandatory taxes when assessing real income for maintenance; no independent trusted same-event report was indexed by cutoff.

sourcesScanned.scope: State of Andhra Pradesh v Ponthati Siva Rami Reddy, 2026 INSC 820
sourcesScanned.result: Verified dismissal of the State appeal because inconsistencies and conjecture could not restore the murder conviction; fact-specific holding scored below 65.
Reviewed 10 August releases; they were VRRR operations, government-security auctions, SGB redemption pricing, statistical releases and one cooperative-bank penalty, with no qualifying policy novelty.

sourcesScanned.publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India
sourcesScanned.result: The latest listed circular remained dated 3 August 2026; no in-window circular was identified.

sourcesScanned.scope: Election Commission press notes and decisions
sourcesScanned.result: The public index required client-side JavaScript and targeted searches found no independently corroborated substantive in-window election-law development.

sourcesScanned.publisher: United Nations, OHCHR and International Court of Justice
sourcesScanned.scope: UN meetings, treaty bodies, human-rights releases and international judicial outcomes
sourcesScanned.result: The UN tax-convention session and treaty-body meetings were ongoing; no completed in-window decision or judgment cleared novelty and publication gates.

sourcesScanned.publisher: The Indian Express, Hindustan Times, Onmanorama, Reuters, NDTV, The Economic Times, LiveLaw and Bar & Bench
sourcesScanned.scope: Independent corroboration and legal background for all shortlisted official-source events
sourcesScanned.result: Found reliable earlier context on tribunal independence, the Kerala name-change process, labour-market data and lion conservation, but no trusted independent same-event report for the four 10 August bills, the 1601-series framework, PLFS bulletin or the Harpreet Sawhney judgment by cutoff.
